name: long_rollout_v1
selection: All 100 validation trajectories at 256 points, full 100-step rollout. Minimize worst temporal-block MSE among checkpoints whose first-five MSE is at most 1.1 times the unmodified initial checkpoint. Include epoch zero. Blocks 1-5,6-20,21-50,51-100. Native-grid validation reports final and selected, and cannot change selection.
compute_caveat: 60 additional epochs, progressively longer rollouts; fresh Adam and cosine schedule.
interpretation: A separately budgeted fine-tune with a new Adam optimizer and cosine schedule. It does not extend the old schedule or change the paper result. Failure does not rule out a from-scratch curriculum. Validation improvements require fresh-seed and untouched-data confirmation. No test inference or selection. No claim of arbitrary long-horizon accuracy.
